slides.headline: what to say when they missed the deadline
slides.sub: four things i do before that talk

slides.headline: bring one clear example
slides.sub: pick one miss, not a list. “the draft was due tuesday and i got it thursday.”

slides.headline: say it out loud first
slides.sub: i use an app called Steady for this. you talk to an ai person who answers like a real one and pushes back

slides.headline: ask what got in the way
slides.sub: try “what happened here?” then stop. let them finish before you fix it.

slides.headline: end with the next due date
slides.sub: be plain. “i need the next draft by noon friday. if that changes, tell me before then.”

slides.headline: which part of this talk do you avoid?

caption:
when the work is late, the hardest part is not sounding sharp or vague at the same time.

you can save this for the next deadline talk or send it to a manager friend.

the app is Steady, link in bio.
